description.value: You make excellent use of your legs and are quite skilled at leaping. Some atraxids get around not only by walking or climbing, but jumping, easily leaping from surface to surface. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Quick Jump] skill feat.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
